title: values/cluster-vars.yaml
description: An env's cluster values: values/cluster-vars.yaml. Rules that span fields (the CIDRs, the App DNS address, LAN ranges, known hosts, the time zone, paths) are checked by jarvis validate.

x-messages.dependentRequired: k3s_version and k3s_sha256 override core's k3s release together; set both or neither

age_key_file.description: The working age key on the controller: Flux's sops-age is made from it, and the k3s tokens are read with it. SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE overrides it.

app_dns_cluster_ip.description: ClusterIP of the App DNS Service, which cluster DNS forwards the zone to. A host address inside service_cidr, not its first address (the Kubernetes API) or its tenth (cluster DNS).

apps_git_repo_url.description: The hosted apps repository, https, read with no credential. Anyone's: the example apps beside core, or your own.

backup_check_schedule.description: Five-field cron for the weekly restic repository check (CronJob platform-backups/restic-check), in time_zone. The check takes no lock, so it never blocks a backup; a prune at the same time can fail one run, and the Job retries.

x-messages.type: backup_check_schedule must be a five-field cron
x-messages.pattern: backup_check_schedule must be a five-field cron

backup_path.description: Absolute path on the backup node: etcd snapshots under backup_path/etcd-snapshots, and one restic repository per PVC under backup_path/restic/ns-<namespace>/pvc-<pvc>.

backup_retention_daily.description: Daily snapshots restic keeps, per PVC.

backup_retention_monthly.description: Monthly snapshots restic keeps, per PVC.

backup_retention_weekly.description: Weekly snapshots restic keeps, per PVC.

backup_schedule.description: Five-field cron for each PVC's backup (its VolSync ReplicationSource), in time_zone.

x-messages.type: backup_schedule must be a five-field cron
x-messages.pattern: backup_schedule must be a five-field cron

chrony_nts.description: Whether chrony asks the pools for NTS. false for a LAN or router time source that does not speak it. Host-only (Ansible).

core_git_ref.description: The core release the env runs: refs/tags/<tag>. Every jarvis command runs that release, and refuses a branch ref.

x-messages.type: core_git_ref must be a non-empty string
x-messages.pattern: core_git_ref must be a non-empty string

core_git_repo_url.description: The public core repository, Flux's core source. https, read with no credential.

dns_suffix.description: The env's internal DNS zone: services are <name>.<dns_suffix>, hosted apps <app>.apps.<dns_suffix>. A lowercase DNS name.

flux_git_ref.description: The root source's Git ref, e.g. refs/heads/main.

flux_git_repo_url.description: The env repository, Flux's root source. https:// with no userinfo, query or fragment, or ssh://<user>@<host>/<owner>/<repo>, read with the sealed deploy key.

flux_known_hosts.description: SSH known_hosts lines Flux trusts for an ssh:// root; the root's host must be among them. Unset, GitHub's published key. Host-only (Ansible).
flux_known_hosts.x-required: for an ssh:// root not on github.com

jarvis_env.description: The env's name: its folder under envs/, the /etc/jarvis/env marker on its nodes, and the name its guards check.

k3s_kubelet_eviction_hard.description: kubelet eviction-hard. Its memory.available is raised to node_memory_reserve_percent when that is larger. A host may override it.

x-messages.type: k3s_kubelet_eviction_hard must be a non-empty string
x-messages.pattern: k3s_kubelet_eviction_hard must be a non-empty string

k3s_kubelet_kube_reserved.description: kubelet kube-reserved, without the kube-reserved= prefix. A host may override it.

x-messages.type: k3s_kubelet_kube_reserved must be a non-empty string
x-messages.pattern: k3s_kubelet_kube_reserved must be a non-empty string

k3s_kubelet_system_reserved.description: kubelet system-reserved, without the system-reserved= prefix. A host may override it.

x-messages.type: k3s_kubelet_system_reserved must be a non-empty string
x-messages.pattern: k3s_kubelet_system_reserved must be a non-empty string

k3s_sha256.description: SHA-256 of that release's amd64 k3s binary, checked on install.

x-messages.type: k3s_sha256 must be a 64-character lowercase hex string
x-messages.pattern: k3s_sha256 must be a 64-character lowercase hex string

k3s_version.description: A k3s release in place of core's (v<major>.<minor>.<patch>+k3s<n>). Set with k3s_sha256, or neither. The host binary changes only by a pull request.

x-messages.type: k3s_version must be a k3s version string (v<major>.<minor>.<patch>+k3s<n>)
x-messages.pattern: k3s_version must be a k3s version string (v<major>.<minor>.<patch>+k3s<n>)

lan_cidrs.description: The LAN's ranges: IPv4 CIDRs inside RFC 1918, clear of pod_cidr and service_cidr. Hosted apps' internet egress excludes them; lan-all opens them and a lan-target range sits inside them. Not published to the cluster; the app wiring render carries it.
lan_cidrs.x-required: when apps.yaml grants lan-all or lan-target

local_path_data.description: Where the k3s local-path provisioner keeps volumes: a subdirectory of /var/lib/jarvis, not the mount itself.

node_memory_reserve_percent.description: The share of every node's memory no pod is scheduled into (0 to 50): the kubelet's memory.available hard eviction threshold. Under it, pods over their requests are evicted first, by priority, before the kernel's OOM killer acts. 0 leaves eviction-hard as written. Host-only (Ansible).

x-messages.type: node_memory_reserve_percent must be an integer from 0 to 50
x-messages.minimum: node_memory_reserve_percent must be an integer from 0 to 50
x-messages.maximum: node_memory_reserve_percent must be an integer from 0 to 50

ntp_pools.description: Chrony pool hostnames for the nodes, one pool line each (with nts while chrony_nts is on).

pod_cidr.description: The pod network, set once per env.

service_cidr.description: The service network, set once per env.

ssh_user.description: The user Ansible logs in to the nodes as; tasks run as root through sudo. jarvis init writes the user who ran it. A host's own ssh_user overrides it.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for the nodes and for every schedule (VolSync, the restic check). Unknown names fail.
